review_notes: The file has one theorem, lines 1–75. I read the dependencies it uses. `eq_of_comp_indK0_eq_of_cyclic_coprime` and the modular Artin lemmas in Spanning.lean need `[Fact p.Prime]` and `[CharP k p]`. `forall_localEulerCharacteristic_eq_localCardNorm_iff` in GrothendieckGroup.lean is already stated for a general `n` with `IsUnit (n : F)`. The only specialisation in the target is `ℓ` prime with coefficients `ZMod ℓ`. This is forced by the modular Artin induction. For composite `n`, `ZMod n` is not a field, so the induction theorem does not apply without new mathematics. The hypothesis `h` is already restricted to cyclic subgroups of order prime to `ℓ`, and it quantifies over all `FDRep (ZMod ℓ) C`. I found no useful weakening or generalisation that avoids substantial new mathematics. I did not check the definitions of the Euler characteristic or `indFDRep` in depth.
